CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible Story: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Story: has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   C. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Say Adam and has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.
   C. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Easter Life of Jesus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Trust Christian Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
